model_and_training.preprocessing: Pillow RGB, BILINEAR resize, divide by 255, CHW
model_and_training.target_distribution: unit-mass Gaussian on the finite heatmap lattice
model_and_training.shuffle: CPU torch.Generator seeded once; randperm each epoch

cpu_reason: Small fixed model and sample; explicit portable CPU reference chosen before results, not a device-speed competition.
checkpoint_policy: Train all six fixed final-epoch checkpoints, hash and seal ledger, then evaluate. No target-game checkpoint selection, early stopping, best seed selection, augmentation, hyperparameter search or retries.
baselines: Normalized training-game point mean, projected into the target camera crop
coordinate_contract: u=(x-left)/crop_width; v=(y-top)/crop_height. Model heatmap expected pixel centers. No clipping/replacement of out-of-crop references. Original-pixel and normalized-crop discrepancies are distinct.
reporting: Every marked target frame remains in its per-seed denominator with errors/missing counts. Per-direction and per-seed pooled median/p90 plus paired model-minus-baseline differences. Repeated seeds are not independent frames; no population CI from two development games.
next_candidate_gate: Only nominate this candidate for later development if all six arms have complete predictions and both median and p90 original-pixel discrepancy are lower than BOTH baselines in every arm. Regardless of gate, no service adoption or independent accuracy claim from this study.
timing_scope: Training and held-out batch inference durations only; not video service latency or single-frame publication.
limitations: Known marked legacy frames and manually fixed game crops; conditional point regression, not detection.
No bounding-box, mask, current-protocol negative, calibrated confidence, or abstention training.
Both games were previously reviewed and used for development. Cross-game training separation does not make them unseen.
Legacy coordinates are not certified equivalent to the current visible mitt-body center.
No verified catcher identity, pitcher intent, physical-coordinate accuracy, pre-pitch availability, or policy utility.
revision_reason: Read-only pre-training audit found output JSON hashes were adopted only at report completion. Freeze hashes when writing and verify them at completion; no model/training/evaluation settings changed.
